<?php
function brace_ctrl2() {
    echo "BEGIN|";
    declare(ticks=0)
    {
    }
    echo "END|";
    return 13;
}
$value = brace_ctrl2();
echo "RESULT|", $value, "|";

<?php
function colon_ctrl2() {
    $count = 0;
    $total = 0;
    while ($count < 3) {
        $count = $count + 1;
        declare(ticks=0)
        :
        enddeclare;
        if ($count === 2) {
            continue;
        }
        $total = $total + $count;
        echo "BODY|", $count, "|";
    }
    echo "COUNT|", $count, "|";
    return $total;
}
$value = colon_ctrl2();
echo "RESULT|", $value, "|";
